note: Community tab. `givenTotalUSD` is a config constant that starts at zero — the app makes no claim about money given until money has been given, and the card shows it honestly as $0. `totalGivenUSD` is the Phase-1 spelling of the same number, kept as an alias so Tests/StudyContentTests/BundledJSONTests.swift still decodes; the two must stay equal and FeatureCommunityTests asserts that. Votes are stored locally in prefs.json; there is no server. `image` is the artwork slug in App/Assets.xcassets (`Charity-<image>`); no real logos are bundled.
headline: Given to charities
subline: Every subscription gives a share back to the Ummah.
voteBody: A portion of all proceeds across the entire app goes to one of these charities each month. Subscribers get one vote to choose who receives it.

organisations.name: Islamic Relief Worldwide
organisations.blurb: Emergency response and long-term development in more than 40 countries, working through local offices rather than parachuting in.

organisations.name: Penny Appeal
organisations.blurb: Small, regular giving pooled into water, orphan care and food programmes, built around the idea that consistency beats size.

organisations.name: Human Appeal
organisations.blurb: Health, education and livelihood programmes alongside emergency response, with published country-level reporting.
